get.summary: List assigned users for a maid
get.description: Returns the users currently assigned to the specified maid. A user is treated as `leaving` when their status is "leaving" (case-insensitive); any other status is treated as `serving`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter assigned users by engagement state. Accepts `serving`, `leaving`, or `both` (default).

status_filter.description: Query filter for engagement state. `both` returns every assigned user while still tagging each row.

status.description: Current free-form status text for the user.

instax_id.description: instax identifier associated with the user.

is_valid.description: Indicates if the user is currently valid.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

engagement_state.description: Derived engagement state. `leaving` when the user status equals "leaving" (case-insensitive), otherwise `serving`.

items.description: User assigned to a maid together with the derived engagement state.

data.description: Assigned users grouped by engagement state.
